projects.allProjectsDescription: An additional selection showing a wider range of contexts, stacks, and business problems.

meta-ads-conversations.title: Meta Ads Campaigns - Conversations & Engagement
meta-ads-conversations.description: Not just clicks - real conversations. These Meta Ads campaigns were built around WhatsApp & Messenger intent, driving 5,000+ direct exchanges at a cost per conversation as low as $0.18.
meta-ads-conversations.impact: 3.6M+ impressions and 577k+ people reached. Over 5,000 WhatsApp & Messenger conversations triggered, with cost per conversation pushed as low as $0.18 through continuous creative iteration and bid optimization.

mindease.title: MindEase - Emotional Support Built for West Africa
mindease.description: Mental health support is scarce and often misaligned with West African realities. MindEase delivers emotional tracking and AI-driven recommendations across mobile, web, and WhatsApp - meeting people where they already are.
mindease.impact: Accessible without installation via WhatsApp, or through the web and mobile app. AI recommendations adapt to the user's profile and local context, providing real preventive support without requiring professional therapy.

propiflow.title: Propiflow - Rental Management Without the Spreadsheets
propiflow.description: Rental management shouldn't live in scattered spreadsheets and phone calls. Propiflow brings properties, tenants, contracts, and maintenance into one place - with a dedicated mobile app for tenants.
propiflow.impact: All rental operations centralized in one place. Tenants have their own mobile interface, maintenance requests are tracked in real time, and repetitive admin tasks are gone.

kawari-finance-app.title: Kawari Finance App - Budget Clarity & AI
kawari-finance-app.description: Knowing what you spend is a start. Understanding why and deciding differently is where Kawari comes in - financial flow visualization and actionable AI recommendations built into one app.
kawari-finance-app.impact: A clear view of spending changes behavior. AI recommendations help users spot drift, identify priority expense areas, and make better financial decisions day to day.

sud-stratvision.title: SUD-StratVision - Centralized Strategic Management
sud-stratvision.description: When goals live in Excel and missions are tracked by email, decisions arrive too late. SUD-StratVision pulls everything together - objectives, performance, HR, leave, and training - in one dashboard.
sud-stratvision.impact: Immediate adoption by teams from day one. Decision-makers finally have a consolidated real-time view without chasing down files scattered across departments.

clinic-appointment-scheduler.title: Clinic Appointment Scheduler - No More Scheduling Chaos
clinic-appointment-scheduler.description: Phone-based appointment booking means missed slots, scheduling conflicts, and frustrated patients. This Flutter app gives patients, doctors, and admins a shared real-time view to coordinate without friction.
clinic-appointment-scheduler.impact: Scheduling conflicts and forgotten appointments are gone. Patients book autonomously, doctors manage their availability, and admins have full visibility across all clinic coordination.

offline-gpt.title: Offline GPT - Local AI Without Internet
offline-gpt.description: What if a GPT-like assistant worked with no internet? This R&D project explores running a local LLM on mobile - a practical path to AI accessibility in places where connectivity isn't guaranteed.
offline-gpt.impact: A full LLM running locally on a mobile device - no server, no data connection needed. A real step toward democratizing AI in contexts where network infrastructure remains a barrier.
offline-gpt.microcopy: Work in progress - contributions and feedback welcome.

make-social-automation.title: Social Media Automation - Google Sheets → Facebook & Instagram
make-social-automation.description: Posting manually to Facebook and Instagram every week is time nobody has. This Make pipeline reads a Google Sheet, publishes to both platforms automatically, and updates status without any human touch.
make-social-automation.impact: Hours of manual publishing eliminated every week. Content goes out on time across both platforms, status updates automatically, and nothing slips through the cracks.

telegram-youtube-summarizer.title: AI Telegram Bot - Instant YouTube Summaries
telegram-youtube-summarizer.description: Drop a YouTube link in the bot, get a clean AI summary in seconds. No more sitting through 40-minute videos just to extract the key points.
telegram-youtube-summarizer.impact: YouTube monitoring becomes passive. The modular architecture makes it easy to add new content sources or output channels as needs evolve - the bot grows with the workflow.

bfa-administration-assistant.title: BFA Administration Assistant - Institutional RAG
bfa-administration-assistant.description: A RAG assistant trained on real institutional documents to answer admin questions in seconds. Built for a local context where procedures change often and staff spend too much time searching for answers.
bfa-administration-assistant.impact: Agents find answers in seconds instead of digging through PDFs. Accurate, grounded in the institution's real documentation - operational from day one.

sud-develop-website.title: SUD Develop - Multilingual Corporate Website
sud-develop-website.description: SUD Develop's first serious digital presence. A multilingual corporate site with a clear structure, division overview, and integrated quote request form to turn visits into real leads.
sud-develop-website.impact: Stronger online presence with a site that actually reflects SUD Develop's offering. The integrated quote module converts visits into qualified business opportunities without an email back-and-forth.

anam-meteo-eval.title: ANAM Meteo Eval - 2025 AI Hackathon Winner
anam-meteo-eval.description: Built in 48 hours at the 2025 AI Hackathon, then delivered to Burkina Faso's National Meteorological Agency. It automatically evaluates weather data quality with reliable, actionable metrics.
anam-meteo-eval.impact: Award-winning at the 2025 AI Hackathon and deployed with ANAM. It automates weather data quality assessment with metrics that directly improve forecast reliability.

cv-studio.title: CV Studio - Modern Resumes in Minutes
cv-studio.description: Building a standout resume shouldn't take a full day. CV Studio walks users through a step-by-step flow to produce a polished, modern document - no design skills or Word gymnastics required.
cv-studio.impact: Modern CVs in minutes, no design background needed. Users leave with a structured, readable document ready to send - removing what was previously a real barrier to job applications.

gestion-bibliotheque.title: Library Management - Loans, Returns & Alerts
gestion-bibliotheque.description: A well-run library means books that actually circulate. This Laravel/MySQL system handles loans, returns, and users - with automated alerts to prevent losses before they happen.
gestion-bibliotheque.impact: Automated loan tracking, overdue alerts, per-user history. A tool that makes the library easier to manage and books more accessible to readers.

bytemarket.title: ByteMarket - Vanilla JS E-commerce
bytemarket.description: An e-commerce site built from scratch in pure HTML/CSS/JS - no framework, no shortcuts. A deliberate exercise in mastering the web fundamentals before moving on to modern stacks.
bytemarket.impact: Building without dependencies means understanding every line. ByteMarket laid the foundation for a serious web approach - the discipline from this work shows in every project that followed.

a1.title: Are you a student? You literally have access to +$200K in FREE tools… and you might not even know it.
a1.summary: GitHub Education gives students free access to the same tools professional developers use: Azure cloud credits, a free .dev domain, GitHub Pro, premium courses, and much more. A massive advantage most students overlook.

a2.title: Winning the 2025 AI Hackathon - what I learned in 48 hours
a2.summary: The story of the ANAM Météo project: how we designed, built, and presented an AI solution for meteorological data evaluation in under 48 hours.

a3.title: Building a Telegram bot that auto-summarizes YouTube videos with n8n
a3.summary: Architecture of an AI agent using n8n: YouTube link detection, transcript extraction, LLM summary, and Telegram response in a single pipeline.

a4.title: This website taught me what never to do in UX/UI
a4.summary: User Inyerface, built by Belgian agency Bagaar, illustrates the worst UX practices in a playful way. An experience that opened my eyes to the importance of user-centered design.

a5.title: Your CPA is too high? The problem is probably not your ad budget.
a5.summary: On most projects I work on, the issue isn't the ads - it's the system around them. CPA between $0.18 and $0.25, 1,500+ conversations: that's what a well-structured funnel delivers.
